task.description: Implement OBS-03 end-to-end backend functionality following src/design/obs-03-audit-log.md. Add immutable audit persistence for successful state-changing API requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) with required fields: audit_id UUID, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, timestamp, before_state, after_state. Ensure audit insert executes in the same DB transaction as business mutation and that any audit write failure rolls back the whole transaction. Implement action naming and actor extraction conventions, exclude GET/read-only requests, and handle canceled-token post-auth actions per requirement. Implement GET /audit with filters actor_id, resource_type, resource_id, from, to and API-06-compatible pagination/ordering behavior. Ensure no API supports modifying/deleting audit records. Include necessary migration/schema/index updates and comprehensive unit/integration tests for acceptance criteria and edge cases. Run required validations: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and error-set check before completion.
acceptance_criteria: All OBS-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases are implemented and test-covered
Audit write is atomic with state changes in same transaction and rollback semantics are enforced
Read-only requests do not produce audit records
zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate complete successfully

result.summary: Implemented OBS-03 backend audit logging via immutable audit persistence schema and triggers, added audit query service plus GET /audit route with filters/cursor pagination, and added integration coverage for create-audit/read-only exclusion/list behavior.
